title: lophiolepis bracteosa
intro: Lophiolepis bracteosa, commonly known as Himalayan club moss, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and act as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help in treating conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Lophiolepis bracteosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
